sentences.japanese: このような木製の鉢を作る技術はすっかりすたれてしまった。
sentences.english: The art of making wooden bowls like these has died out.

sentences.japanese: ガラスの鉢は粉々になってしまった。
sentences.english: The glass bowl broke into tiny fragments.

sentences.japanese: 彼女はだんだん、捨て鉢になった。
sentences.english: She was beginning to get desperate.

sentences.japanese: 彼は粘土で鉢をつくった。
sentences.english: He formed the clay into a bowl.

sentences.japanese: 彼女は鉢から花を摘んで、私にくれました。
sentences.english: She picked a flower from the pot and gave it to me.
